_comment: Configuration for the BlenderProc oven scene: this directory is the scene.
The pair is left_on.png / right_on.png, 640x480, rendered from the 320x240 rig
described by camera.json (fx = fy = 140 px, cx = 319.5, cy = 239.5, baseline 60 mm).
Every key is optional; precedence is defaults < top-level keys < profiles[profile].
Image paths are never configured here: the caller injects them through
minimal uses MODE_SGBM: five directions, single pass, and no full-image cost volume,
so its peak memory does not scale with height x width x numDisparities. Measured on
this pair: 34.1 MB peak and 193 ms match, against 38.4 MB / 51 ms for the 3-way sweep
and 163.2 MB / 330 ms for the eight-direction one. Median disparity 74.13 px against
74.44 and 74.94 (scene ground truth 73.26 px), valid 72.4 % against 74.8 and 74.9.
It is the cheapest in memory, not the fastest: raise the profile when wall-clock time
or the extra valid pixels matter more.
The rig is described by R = I and zero distortion, so rectifying an already rectified
pair is an identity mapping. crop_to_common_roi stays off because the ROI stereoRectify
derives is one pixel inside the frame, and losing that row and column would stop the
result from lining up with the scene's own ground-truth maps.
